## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: run the milestone-nav vitest suite through the App entry, then the flat-fallback, selection, and collapse checks, and leave the Proof demo for human sign-off.

## Approach

Run the file-scoped vitest suite for milestone helpers and UI. Confirm the Phases block mounts with fixture milestones (integration through the Svelte App). Confirm flat stepper when milestones are empty. Confirm select/All-phases scoping and collapse defaults. Human confirms web-calm grouping on the live dashboard (Proof).
record.subject: verify-milestone-nav
